mapper.select: SELECT bd.id AS id, CAST(#{orgId} AS UNSIGNED) AS org_id, bd.department_code AS dept_code, bd.department_name AS dept_name, bd.parent_id AS parent_id, bd.department_type AS dept_type, bd.manager_id AS manager_id, bd.manager_name AS manager_name, bd.department_level AS level, bd.sort_order AS sort_order, CASE WHEN bd.department_status = '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status, bd.remarks AS remark, bd.create_time AS create_time, bd.update_time AS update_time FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_department bd WHERE bd.del_flag = 0 AND ( bd.org_id = CAST(#{orgId} AS CHAR) OR FIND_IN_SET(CAST(#{orgId} AS CHAR), bd.org_id) > 0 ) ORDER BY bd.sort_order ASC, bd.create_time ASC

SELECT bd.id AS dept_id, bd.org_id, bd.department_code AS dept_code, bd.department_name AS dept_name, bd.parent_id, bd.department_type AS dept_type, bd.manager_id, bd.manager_name, bd.department_level AS level, bd.sort_order, CASE WHEN bd.department_status = '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status, bd.remarks AS remark, bd.create_time, bd.update_time, bd.department_full_name, bd.department_path, bd.department_type, bd.department_status, bd.employee_count, bd.office_location, bd.office_phone, bd.office_email, bd.description, bd.responsibilities FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_department bd WHERE bd.del_flag = 0 AND ( bd.org_id = CAST(#{orgId} AS CHAR) OR FIND_IN_SET(CAST(#{orgId} AS CHAR), bd.org_id) > 0 ) ORDER BY bd.sort_order ASC, bd.create_time ASC

SELECT bd.id AS dept_id, bd.org_id, bd.department_code AS dept_code, bd.department_name AS dept_name, bd.parent_id, bd.department_type AS dept_type, bd.manager_id, bd.manager_name, bd.department_level AS level, bd.sort_order, CASE WHEN bd.department_status = '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status, bd.remarks AS remark, bd.create_time, bd.update_time, bd.department_full_name, bd.department_path, bd.department_type, bd.department_status, bd.employee_count, bd.budget_amount, bd.cost_center_code, bd.office_location, bd.office_phone, bd.office_email, bd.establishment_date, bd.description, bd.responsibilities, bd.remarks FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_department bd WHERE bd.id = #{deptId} AND bd.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
